Md. Alam @ Nabi Alam, S/o Md. Azam, R/o Village- Ward no. 8,
 Maulvichak Nawada, P.S. - Dalsingh Sarai, Distt. - Samastipur

... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Md. Nurul Hoda, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Shyam Bihari Singh, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 13-09-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Dalsingh Sarai P.S. Case No. 03 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 366A and 376/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Allegedly, the minor daughter of the informant was kidnapped and taken away by the petitioner with the help of other accused persons.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that, in fact, the victim girl and the petitioner were in love and finally they solemnized marriage.
However, on account of the fact that the petitioner belongs to different religion, the present FIR has been instituted.
It is next contended that the victim proselytized Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51794 of 2024(2) dt.13-09-2024 herself into Islam and thereafter solemnized marriage with the petitioner.
In support of the aforesaid contention, affidavits have been brought on record.

It is further contended that during the trial with respect to other co-accused persons, the deposition of the victim girl was recorded, wherein she has categorcially stated that she voluntarily left her house and went to Delhi and thereafter proselytized her religion and solemnized marriage with the petitioner.
Now, the victim also blessed with a son.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and submitted that the petitioner remained absconded for such a long time, on account of which the trial has been separated and proceeded with other accused persons.

6. Regard being had to the submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the deposition of the victim and the affidavits filed in support of the statements narrated hereinabove, coupled with the fair antecedent of the petitioner, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today,
on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.D.J.-VI-cum-SPL Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51794 of 2024(2)
dt.13-09-2024 (POCSO), Samastipur in connection with Dalsingh Sarai P.S. Case No. 03 of 2022,
subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C, with further condition that one of the bailors shall be the own/close family members of the petitioner.
(Harish Kumar, J) rohit/-
